Between the Sun and Asteroid Belt

items: Venus and Uranus rotate from East to West (retrograde rotation), whereas all other planets rotate from West to East.
Jupiter has the shortest day of all planets in the solar system, completing one full rotation in approximately 9 hours and 55 minutes.
Light from the Sun takes approximately 8 minutes and 20 seconds (500 seconds) to reach Earth.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Big Bang Theory, proposed by Georges Lemaître, is the leading scientific explanation for the origin and expansion of the universe around 13.8 billion years ago.
The Solar System consists of eight planets categorized into Terrestrial (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars) and Jovian (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune) planets.
Venus is referred to as Earth's Twin due to its similar size, mass, and density, and it is the hottest planet in the Solar System.
The Asteroid Belt lies between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter, separating the inner terrestrial planets from the outer gas giants.
In 2006, the International Astronomical Union (IAU) reclassified Pluto as a dwarf planet, establishing three clear criteria for full planet status.
